rows.item: NBA betting offered on Alberta's regulated platform
rows.official_value: NBA 'Bet' tile is shown on Play Alberta's sports section
Operators may conduct registered iGaming from July 13 (2026); all operators must register with AGLC and sign a commercial agreement with AiGC

rows.item: Advertising rule for registered iGaming operators
rows.official_value: Ads must reference responsible-gambling information, including 211 Alberta; athletes appealing to minors may not endorse

rows.item: AGLC guidance on event contracts / prediction markets
rows.official_value: Guidance document 'AGLC iGaming Guidance Document – Event Contracts' is listed on the AGLC iGaming page (title verified; contents not reviewed)

rows.item: NBA memo (Oct 16, 2026) restricting parlays with same-player unders
rows.reported_unverified: Reported by ESPN/Yahoo Sports, Boston Globe and others: sportsbooks told not to offer parlays with the under on the same player's stats.

rows.item: NBA memo: opening-tip winner, 'first-of' markets, missed-shot props
rows.reported_unverified: Reported as banned for sportsbooks this season (Yahoo/ESPN, Boston Globe, Ingame).

rows.item: NBA memo: under bets on players expected to play fewer than 12 minutes
rows.reported_unverified: Reported as banned (ESPN via Yahoo Sports).
